test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Don't park your car here.

options.text: Let your car be parked here
Let not your car be parked here.
Let your car not be parked here
Have not your car be parked here.

solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Don't park your car here."
 
• To convert this to the passive voice, we use the structure "Let + object + not + be + past participle."
 
• In this case, the object is "your car".
 
• The verb "park" in the passive voice becomes "be parked".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Let your car not be parked here."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1:** "Let your car be parked here" – Incorrect, the negative imperative ("don't") is missing.
 
• **Option 2:** "Let not your car be parked here" – Less common and more formal word order for the negative imperative.
 
• **Option 4:** "Have not your car be parked here" – Incorrect structure, "have" is not used in passive imperatives.
